falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a strong bullish trend contradicting the 'HOLD' signal, suggesting the pattern is not a blowoff but a continuation pattern.

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume spikes to exceed the 90th percentile of the past year's daily volume for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a volume surge would invalidate the 'HOLD' by confirming extreme market participation, a key characteristic of blowoff tops rather than a sideways consolidation phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: The Fear & Greed Index (FGI) for the asset class moves above 75 (extreme greed) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would directly contradict the 'HOLD' verdict by showing extreme bullish sentiment, which typically precedes a reversal rather than sustained consolidation.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
